finding: Cleanup-candidate revalidation checks live path identity, size, and modification time but does not reject a file whose filesystem link count increased after the persisted observation.
risk: Deleting one hard-link path may reclaim no allocated blocks, so presenting it as an ordinary cleanup candidate would overstate reclaimable evidence.
required_repair: Require a live st_nlink value of exactly one and prove that adding a hard link after observation removes the object from MCP cleanup candidates.
